hits.snippet: By Colin Kellaher Listen (1 min) Dow has designated its chief operating officer, Karen Carter, to succeed Jim Fitterling as the chemical maker’s chief executive, effective July 1. Bill Pugliano/ Getty Images Dow has designated its chief operating officer, Karen Carter, to succeed Jim Fitterling as the chemical maker’s chief executive, effective July 1. Dow on Tuesday said Fitterling, who has been CEO since August 2018 and board chair since April 2020, will become executive board chair on that date. Carter, 55 years old, joined Dow in 1994 and has been the Midland, Mich., company’s chief operating officer since December 2024.
